2 member team project

Voice-Controlled Wheelchair Prototype

Designed and built a miniature voice-controlled wheelchair integrating embedded machine learning with motor control for hands-free navigation.

Design & Development

  • Designed and 3D-printed a custom chassis integrating a Raspberry Pi Pico, I2S microphone, DC motors, and a motor driver.
  • Built an audio acquisition and processing pipeline, collecting labeled speech data to train a four-class Edge Impulse model (go, reverse, turn, noise).
  • Deployed the model on the microcontroller, translating classified voice commands into directional movement.

Result: ~97% validation accuracy and functional voice-controlled navigation.

Working demo

Multiplayer BCI Gaming Platform

Led the development of a real-time multiplayer BCI gaming platform featuring two EEG-controlled games: a card game using SSVEP-based visual attention and a racing game using concentration-driven changes in alpha-wave activity to control speed.
